# AK-341 -- Escape HTML in email template variables

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | implementation |
| Status | approved (2026-09-18, messaging tech lead) |
| Work source | security review note: account names are rendered unescaped into HTML mail |
| Integration owner | messaging team |
| Prerequisites | none |

## Goal

Values substituted by `render` (`src/email/templates.js`) are inserted into
HTML email bodies without escaping. Escape them by default, and give
templates an explicit way to insert a value that is already trusted HTML.

## Non-goals

- Escaping the template text itself.

## Acceptance criteria

- **AC-1** -- `<` and `>` in a variable's value render as `&lt;` and `&gt;`.
  Verification: `npm run check -- --test-name-pattern="AK-341 AC-1"`
- **AC-2** -- `&`, `"` and `'` in a variable's value render as `&amp;`,
  `&quot;` and `&#39;`.
  Verification: `npm run check -- --test-name-pattern="AK-341 AC-2"`
- **AC-3** -- a triple-brace variable, `{{{ name }}}`, renders its value
  unescaped.
  Verification: `npm run check -- --test-name-pattern="AK-341 AC-3"`

## Allowed changes

- `src/email/templates.js`, `src/email/escape.js` (new)
- `test/email/escape.test.js` (new)
